headline: AI Engineer — agentic systems and the platform underneath them
summary: AI Engineer on the founding team at Colligence Research. I build the product — multi-agent and LLM pipelines over MCP, a code-generation service, the backend APIs behind them — and I own the platform it runs on: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code with OpenTofu and Ansible, observability, alerting, incident response and authentication. The two halves are one job: the engineer who ships the agent workflow is the engineer who carries the pager for it.

_readme_grade: Grade shown as 'First Class (66.6%)'. The percentage is included deliberately: a bare 'First Class' on a UK CV is read as First Class Honours, which means 70%+ here. Naming the figure keeps it accurate and lets a UK reader place it themselves. Source: his VTU marks slip, which states percentage = CGPA x 10.
